scope: Local original compiler input and independently authored device fixtures. The customer game and its assets are excluded.

classicBuild.meaning: Factories were generated and linked into the script manifest. Individual screens require host interaction tests.

input.limits: Programmatic input and Android editor events. Human keyboard candidate selection not measured.

generatedStateSkin.behavior: State-only nested children restore sibling order after reopening. Model replacement updates the bound caption and count.

images.browser: Two local origins. Anonymous image load without a CORS grant reports ioError; with a grant it completes. Neither request sent a cookie.
images.android: Missing packaged asset reports ioError. The next valid 4 by 2 PNG loads successfully and shares the RES texture.

renderTexture.render: Only the requested visible text subregion is rasterized.
renderTexture.android: Both red and green text slices are visible after recoloring; both uploads are released.

debugRefresh.transport: Asset payload only. Excludes the manifest, shell and ADB control traffic.

limits: Live carrier login, payment, account entitlement and production traffic require the operator test environment.
GLES3 isolated subtree filters, and wide legacy blur/glow kernel output, remain outside these device results.
Private SDK members and dynamic calls require project-specific review.

sound.desktop: Old SDK and new classic game in Edge 158. One natural completion received on the owning channel. Stop and replacement produced none.
sound.android: Real MediaPlayer in the trimmed V8 player on Fold7. One completion, old playback ID rejected, zero active media after release.

directReferenceInventory.limits: Direct names in emitted business scripts, plus the four stage paths checked on a real stage. Availability of a name does not establish all its behavior. Dynamic lookups, all old SDK declarations and all customer screens are outside this count.
